description:
This snowmobile trail is managed by the Province through a Partnership Agreement with Powder Mountain Catskiing to better manage snowmobile use on this limited capacity trail.

A user fee is now in effect. You must part at the parking area that is at 400m elevation as this area is within the Rubble Creek Landslide Hazard Zone. Parking below this elevation may result in a fine or towing. This trail is grommed daily, and runs through Roe Creek valley.
directions: Located South of Daisy Lake and South of Rubble Creek Park entrance. Access trailhead via the Chance Creek Forest Service Road. Drive approx. 2.5km to parking lot and trailhead.
title: Roe Creek Snowmobile Trail
